tool_args.old_text: \paragraph{Diagnostic tools for practitioners.} Our analysis yields two zero-cost diagnostics. First, $C_0$ (multi-candidate rate) combined with SC accuracy predicts when symbolic augmentation is unlikely to help: $C_0 < 5\%$ implies degeneration; SC $\geq 60\%$ implies confirmation bias; SC $\leq 40\%$ implies error amplification. Second, the $\kappa$-based Eff-$K$ metric quantifies SC's own scaling ceiling. At Eff-$K \approx 2$ (typical for instruction-tuned models at $K = 12$), traces beyond 12 add negligible independent information regardless of aggregation method---a result that applies to SC itself, not only to SICA. Together, these diagnostics allow practitioners to determine, before any constraint extraction or trace augmentation, whether additional test-time compute is likely to yield returns.

tool_args.old_text: \paragraph{Scale limitations and future work.} Our experiments span 7B--32B parameters, but the method-level interventions (ICG, Contrastive, Debate) that test the independence-accuracy trade-off most directly use Mistral-7B. Whether 14B+ or 70B+ models can simultaneously maintain reasoning quality under independence-promoting interventions is an open question. The independence-accuracy trade-off itself is fundamental---it follows from the correlation structure of same-model outputs---but the location of the Pareto frontier may shift with scale. Holding all pipeline components fixed and varying only constraint source, gold annotations yield $+14.22$\,pp on FOLIO and $+11.50$\,pp on ProofWriter ($p < 0.001$), while the best self-extraction captures only 24.1\% of this ceiling. The \emph{direct} channel limits voting diversity: Eff-$K < 2$ for many conditions (Table~\ref{tab:independence}) confirms that same-model traces violate the CJT independence requirement, explaining the SC plateau. The \emph{indirect} channel operates through constraint quality: correlated traces produce homogeneous constraints, causing MAX-SAT to degenerate to vote counting (Appendix~\ref{app:ablation}). Debate reduces $\kappa$ to 0.15 (Eff-$K = 4.44$) but collapses accuracy by $-18.6$\,pp on FOLIO and $-23.0$\,pp on LogiQA.
